correctness.rationale: Binary carry calculation proves the exact successive marker gaps; 2-adic symmetry around central consecutive markers produces a reflected block, and asymmetric external gaps give its sharp extension limit. The cases zero markers, one marker and at least two markers exhaust all palindromic factors. Distinct central gaps prevent double counting; precise interval inequalities prove the 3 bound. Independent actual-string diagnostic passes 1120 finite base-length cases, which do not replace the infinite proof.
